# Nixora Complete LLM Documentation

> Nixora is the control plane for AI-generated software and AI agents: deployment (along with diagnosis) is the first capability that's live today, not the entire scope of the product.

## Overview & Architecture

Nixora is purpose-built infrastructure designed to bridge the operational gap between local AI code generation and reliable, production-grade cloud deployment. Modern AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI) generate code rapidly, but deploying that code traditionally requires manual containerization, port mapping, environment provisioning, and persistent hosting.

Nixora automates this entire lifecycle:
1. **Live Today**: Zero-config CLI deployment (`nixora deploy`), automated root-cause diagnosis for failed builds (`nixora diagnose`), container status inspection (`nixora status`), and log streaming (`nixora logs`).
2. **Next on Roadmap**: Agent-native deployment target via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, multi-agent access control with per-agent permissions and audit logs, web dashboard, and Fargate infrastructure.
3. **Longer Term**: Deep application understanding, continuous monitoring, real-time observability, autonomous scaling, auto-sleep, auto-retirement, and multi-agent system governance.

## CLI Usage Reference

### Installation
```bash
pip install nixora
```

### Authentication
```bash
nixora login
```
CLI authentication tokens are issued to approved waitlist builders during closed access.

### Core Commands
- `nixora init`: Creates local `nixora.json` configuration file in current directory.
- `nixora deploy`: Auto-detects runtime, containerizes application, issues HTTPS TLS certificates, provisions cloud compute, and returns a live routing URL.
- `nixora diagnose`: Analyzes container failure logs and environment mismatches, outputting direct root-cause explanations and fix instructions.
- `nixora status`: Shows real-time container health, uptime, and assigned HTTPS URL.
- `nixora logs`: Streams live execution logs from container stdout/stderr.

## Key Technical Guides & Articles
- [Deploy Guide: Cursor & Claude Code](https://nixora.co.in/resources/deploy-cursor-claude-code-app-to-production): Practical guide for taking AI agent code to production.
- [Deploy Guide: Gemini CLI & Codex](https://nixora.co.in/resources/deploy-gemini-codex-open-source-ai-apps): Production deployment guide for Gemini CLI, Codex, and open-source AI agent code.
- [MCP Architecture Guide](https://nixora.co.in/resources/mcp-server-cloud-infrastructure-guide): Model Context Protocol for cloud infrastructure and agent deployment.
- [Why AI Code Breaks in Production](https://nixora.co.in/resources/why-ai-agent-output-wont-run-in-production): Analysis of local execution vs production environment gaps.
- [Why Traditional Infra Fails AI Code](https://nixora.co.in/resources/why-traditional-infra-fails-ai-code): Architectural comparison between static cloud infra and AI control planes.
